description: This PHP source file defines the 'OpportunityFormBase' class which provides methods for handling opportunities in the SuiteCRM system. It includes functionalities for duplicate detection, form rendering (both summary and wide forms), and saving opportunity data, including interactions with related entities such as accounts and leads.

classes.name: OpportunityFormBase
classes.description: A class providing form handling and processing for Opportunity records in SuiteCRM, including duplication checks, form rendering, and save operations.

methods.name: checkForDuplicates
methods.description: Checks for duplicate opportunities based on the name submitted via POST with the given prefix.

methods.name: buildTableForm
methods.description: Builds an HTML table form listing potential duplicate opportunities for user review.

methods.name: getForm
methods.description: Returns the HTML form for creating or editing an opportunity.

methods.name: getWideFormBody
methods.description: Generates a comprehensive HTML form for opportunity data input, including account association and date picking.

methods.name: getFormBody
methods.description: Produces a simplified HTML form for opportunity data input, focusing on essential fields.

methods.name: handleSave
methods.description: Processes the form submission to save an opportunity record, handling permissions and optional redirection.
